text.tspan: Heat: where each measure comes from
Per city: actual temperature (sensor) · felt heat (embodied) · searches (action) · news (media). Each panel has its own scale; ★ = city hall.

Sources: gridMET via ClimateEngine + TIGER/Line 2025 Places · ERA5-Land (Fairbanks) · Copernicus ERA5-HEAT UTCI · Nielsen DMA outlines, community GeoJSON (simzou/nielsen-dma), approximate · Natural Earth 1:50m states · Media Cloud collections.
